method: For each model and NVL72 rack type, the AgentX run with the highest output tokens/s per physical GPU above 50 tokens/s/user (reciprocal P90 ITL). Fixed-rate whole-group extrapolation; no quality equivalence or uncached-prefill calibration.

unavailable.reason: No AgentX run above 50 tokens/s/user that fits one rack in the retrieved response.
